name: NIST AI RMF lifecycle testing support (draft)
description: Partial technical evidence mapping for selected AI RMF 1.0 lifecycle testing outcomes. Test success does not establish framework-wide satisfaction.
limitations: This is a narrow unreviewed mapping, not certification or complete coverage of GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE and MANAGE.
The technical checks record outcomes of the selected test suite; they do not establish appropriate metrics, representative testing or deployment approval.
Periodic synthetic probes complement production monitoring; they do not provide complete traffic coverage, stakeholder feedback or incident response.
Only matching product, plan, suite, connection, gateway and policy versions share lifecycle evidence. Failed or incomplete requests are not model compliance conclusions.

controls.title: A versioned test set and runner record is retained
controls.remediation: Retain the test set, runner version, metrics and measurement limits; have their adequacy reviewed.

controls.title: The selected pre-deployment test suite passed
controls.citation: MEASURE introductory lifecycle guidance (partial technical support)
controls.remediation: Run the selected tests for this product and target version before a human deployment decision.

controls.title: The selected operation test suite passed recently
controls.remediation: Run operation tests at the documented interval and investigate failures; retain separate real-use monitoring evidence.

controls.title: Intended use and risk context require review
controls.remediation: Review intended use, users, risk context and target boundaries with relevant stakeholders.

controls.title: Test metrics and unmeasured risks require review
controls.remediation: Review metric suitability, measurement uncertainty, unmeasured risks and the need for repeated samples.

controls.title: Independent assessment requires human evidence
controls.remediation: Retain review by suitable experts who are independent of front-line development.

controls.title: Deployment-context representativeness requires review
controls.remediation: Review whether tests represent intended deployment conditions, users and important failure modes.

controls.title: Monitoring and response arrangements require review
controls.remediation: Review production monitoring, responsible owners, user feedback and incident/change response arrangements.
